A new platform plus a regional push floods the funnel with signals faster than they can be turned into action. Our AI SDR closes that signal-to-action latency, researching, writing, and following up autonomously: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new hires.

Expanding in North America while launching Lightning usually means signals stacking up faster than reps can act. As RevOps, you feel that latency first, and it's hard to show measurable lift when follow-up is the bottleneck.

Want 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Simpro's reply rate likely compares to other field-service software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
